Anya Patel: Heads-up: Pioneer (prospect) wants to onboard a custom 70B mixed-precision model for their healthcare POC. They need latency ~150ms p50 and HIPAA notes. Can we triage compatibility? cc @Mike Chen @Lucas Ortega
Mike Chen: On it. Do we have the model format and tokenizer? HF repo or S3?
Anya Patel: Customer provided tar.gz w/ ckpt + tokenizer.json via s3 link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/pioneer-llm/pioneer-70b.tar.gz (shared) — shared creds in 1:1. They mentioned it's a FlashAttention variant.
Lucas Ortega: We need model meta: dtypes (fp16/int8), kv-cache layout, parallelism strategy. If it's custom FlashAttn kernels, runtime might need quantization profile. @Riya can you run a quick catalog preflight?
Riya Singh: Starting preflight. Quick note: if it's int4 quantized we need variant or convert; int8 likely OK. ETA ~30m.
Ben Carroll: Enterprise asks: KMS + no egress logs, SOC2 controls. Also pricing Q: POC expects ~500k tok/day peak. How to price for Dedicated vs Hosted burst? @Anya
Anya Patel: They're price sensitive; want ballpark for hosted w/ model variant (quantized) vs Dedicated reserved pool. Include KV cache savings estimates.
Mike Chen: For preflight: can you drop the model into a test runner? Use `rw-infer preflight --model s3://... --output /tmp/pioneer-report.json` (pseudo). Capture max batch size for 150ms p50.
Riya Singh: Ran quick run. Observations: model uses FP16 weights, custom rotary embeddings. KV cache layout compatible with standard llama-family layout. Perf note: single-GPU 80GB OOM at 2-token gen with default batch. Need 2x A100-80 or quantize to fit on 40GB.
Lucas Ortega: That suggests we need quantized 4-bit variant or sharded serving. For POC timeline, recommending: 1) try dynamic quantization to 8-bit; 2) build KV-cache-friendly adapter; 3) if >150ms p50 not achievable, route to smaller 30B variant.
Anya Patel: Customer asked about fallbacks: they'd accept slightly lower-quality 34B if latency hits. Also security: they need dedicated VPC and HSM for keys.
Ben Carroll: On KMS/HSM: Private deployment required for HIPAA. We can offer Private with customer-managed KMS + audit logs. Upsell opportunity.
Riya Singh: Quantization test: int8 conversion reduces memory ~45% and p50 down to ~190ms on 80GB. Further int4 conversion experimental — needs calibration and quality evals. Would like an eval set from Pioneer.
Mike Chen: Requesting Pioneer eval set ASAP. Also need sample prompts to check hallucination/regression after quantization. Can sales secure dataset NDA?
Anya Patel: I'll follow up. Proposed POC plan: week1 preflight + quant test; week2 dedicated private deployment proto + eval; week3 tuning and pricing review. Thoughts?
Lucas Ortega: Agreed. Add rollbacks: model variant fallback routing in routing policy; autoscale to 2x if burst. Also include cost estimate: quantized hosted ~30% cheaper than non-quantized.
Ben Carroll: :thumbsup: I'll draft pricing ranges and the security checklist we need for legal. Ping when eval set is available.
Anya Patel: Thanks team. @InfraBot please create a POC ticket with label `sales/pioneer` and link S3.
InfraBot: Created ticket INF-2024-1192: POC Pioneer onboarding. Assigned to @Riya Singh, @Lucas Ortega, @Mike Chen. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-2024-1192
Riya Singh: I uploaded a short preflight report to the ticket. Highlights: needs quantization for single-GPU; recommend Private for HIPAA. Attaching perf numbers.
